note: The first real conversation with the live agent, with the project author playing the prospect. Committed exactly as ElevenLabs stored it.

turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Meridian Communications. I'll keep this under a minute. Is now an okay time?
Great, thanks. Meridian works with companies on press coverage. I'm calling to ask if you have any news coming up in the next few months that might be worth pitching to journalists?
Hmm. I guess we could talk about, uh, updates in the company, like stock.
Okay, stock updates. Can you tell me a bit more about what's happening there? Is it something like new funding, going public, or a different kind of stock news?
Yeah, our pl- our company is planning on going public in the next two weeks.

That's significant news. Going public is definitely something that could be worth pitching. It sounds like this could be relevant for a conversation with one of our consultants. Would you be open to a short follow-up call with them to discuss how to approach the coverage?
Perfect. I'll get that scheduled for you. Someone from Meridian will reach out shortly to set up a time that works. Thanks for your time today, and best of luck with the IPO.
You're welcome. Have a great day!
